parts.name: shaft_cap
parts.supports: Single X12 outer face down (+90 degrees about Y), including body, rail wings and all four screw seats; 4.2 mm rail thickness. Slicer/support review still required; no support-free claim.

parts.name: carrier
parts.supports: Canonical +90-degree Y orientation. Mirrored 35-degree band slot without square cap; cuff stud unchanged. Previous fixed-angle-35 slice predates this cleat revision; reslice before printing. Band seating, TPU retention and strength need testing.

parts.name: sliding_jaw
parts.supports: Rear X=-10 down (-90 degrees about Y). Uncapped 35-degree band slot; lower projection restored to its original extent. Tongue and cuff studs unchanged. Previous angle-35 zero-support slice predates this revision; reslice before printing. Strength and retention unqualified.

parts.name: phone_cuff
parts.supports: Common 21.6 mm TPU cuff, back down. User reports tiny first-layer supports unnecessary; cuff batch disables support. Not a complete-jaw qualification.

parts.name: actuator_bracket
parts.supports: Common flat Y5.4 back face down (-90 degrees about X). Outer pulley cheek/arm and raised plinth removed; remaining boss raised 2 mm. Extended curved guide and independent return stop. Fresh slice required; support savings and cantilever strength unqualified.

parts.name: plunger
parts.supports: Rounded shoe and cleat need slice review; keep supports off guide surfaces.

parts.name: pulley
parts.supports: Axis vertical, flange on bed. Keep bore and cord groove clean; running clearance unvalidated.

parts.name: pulley_axle
parts.supports: No thread. Head-down orientation provisional; cross-key slot needs slice review.

parts.name: pulley_key
parts.supports: Flat cross-key; preserve square load faces and band seats. Orientation provisional.

parts.name: collar_screw
parts.supports: Head on bed; longer 8×3 profile, flush tip. New grip length requires fit and loaded tests.

parts.name: thumb_nut
parts.supports: Flat on bed; no supports. Fit trial first.

parts.name: clip_string_guide
parts.supports: Axial end flat on bed; vertical 4 mm hole and constant-section clip. TPU 95A. Fresh slice and physical snap-fit test required; no support-free claim before slicing.
